issue.body:
User creation is currently only possible outside the modular service system, and definitely only outside the portable part.

Considerations
- Not all service managers support user creation. E.g. supervisord, process-compose
- Ideally users don't have to specify names or worry too much about collisions
- NixOS can allocate ids dynamically, nix-darwin cannot

Proposal:

By default, each service gets its own user, on platforms that support users.
Platforms that don't support users set the option values to `null`.

New hybrid service-or-service-manager-defined options in mutually exclusive-ish groups
- Inherit
  - `identity.inherit` type: `nullOr <service reference>`, tbd
- Numeric
  - `identity.uid`: `nullOr int`
  - `identity.gid`: `nullOr int`
  - `identity.gids`: `nullOr (listOf int)`
- Named
  - `identity.user`:  `nullOr str`
  - `identity.group`:  `nullOr str`
  - `identity.groups`:  `nullOr (listOf str)`

Numeric and named *might* not be mutually exclusive on some platforms.

Service manager module must use `apply` to override option values so that they have the real value or `null`.
(not `mkForce` because that would be infinite recursion)

Not sure if we can make do with so relatively few options and apply. Alternatively, make the source of the information explicit, e.g: `platform.identity` vs `request.identity` or something along those lines.
